arguments.subject: Portable Bluetooth Speaker manual & support
arguments.body:
Hi Tom,

Here's the information for your Portable Bluetooth Speaker (SKU-1016):

You can find the full manual on our website by:
1. Going to TechMart.com/support
2. Searching for "SKU-1016" or "Portable Bluetooth Speaker"

- Enable Bluetooth on your device
- Select "Portable Speaker" from available devices
- The speaker can only connect to one device at a time

If you need help with any specific features, just reply to this email!

Best,
TechMart Support

emails_sent.subject: Portable Bluetooth Speaker manual & support
emails_sent.body:
Hi Tom,

Here's the information for your Portable Bluetooth Speaker (SKU-1016):

You can find the full manual on our website by:
1. Going to TechMart.com/support
2. Searching for "SKU-1016" or "Portable Bluetooth Speaker"
3. Clicking "Download Manual" on the product page

For Bluetooth pairing: 
- Turn on the speaker (hold power button 3 seconds)
- Enable Bluetooth on your device
- Select "Portable Speaker" from available devices
- The speaker can only connect to one device at a time

If you need help with any specific features, just reply to this email!

Best,
TechMart Support
